meta_title: BURNING BROS. | Delivery Driver Recruitment / Tokyo & Kanagawa
meta_description: Join BURNING BROS. as a freelance delivery driver in Tokyo & Kanagawa. ¥143~/package, full commission. No experience needed. Company housing support available.
hero_lead: Freelance delivery driver in Tokyo & Kanagawa. ¥143~/package. Full commission. No experience needed.
housing_badge: We sign the lease for you.
housing_desc: Can't pass rental screening? We contract the apartment under our company name. Focus on driving, not paperwork.
visa_subtitle: Select your visa type to see if you can apply
visa_not_eligible: Unfortunately, this visa type cannot be used for freelance delivery work.
visa_special: Your visa requires individual review. Please contact us.
income_piece_desc: ¥143~/package delivered. The more you deliver, the more you earn.
income_role_desc: Leadership bonuses for team management roles.
income_residual_desc: ¥22/package from every driver you refer — ongoing, as long as they deliver.
referral_desc: Introduce a friend → earn ¥22 per package they deliver. Not a one-time bonus — it's ongoing income.
referral_example: Your friend delivers 50/day × ¥22 = ¥1,100/day for you. That's ¥33,000/month — just from one referral.
japanese_desc: You don't need JLPT. Just these practical skills:
japanese_check1: Can read delivery app in Japanese
japanese_check3: Can say basic greetings ("Here's your package", "Please sign here")
japanese_check4: Can explain simple situations on the phone
japanese_unsure: Not sure? Take a quick test on LINE!
tax_desc: As a freelancer, you need to file taxes. Don't worry — our experienced drivers will guide you through your first filing. This is important for visa renewal too.
network_desc: Join drivers from your home country. Coming soon.
faq_q1: Do I need my own vehicle?
faq_a1: No. We can arrange a vehicle for you. Lease options are available.
faq_a2: Valid residence card, driver's license (Japanese), and bank account for payments.
faq_q3: Can I choose my working days?
faq_a3: Yes. As a freelance contractor, you set your own schedule.
faq_a4: Yes. Experienced drivers will train you during your first week.
faq_a5: After visa verification and a short orientation, you can start within 1 week.
faq_a7: Vehicle insurance is included in the lease. We recommend personal accident insurance separately.
faq_a8: Monthly bank transfer. All packages delivered are tracked and calculated automatically.
cta_subtitle: Talk to us on LINE — we reply in your language.
